project_name: Lincoln Star Improvement and Service District data-center-enabling district
developer: Lincoln Star Improvement and Service District
status_detail: County legal notices and filings describe a proposed improvement and service district whose initial services include fiber optic network infrastructure, data centers, business parks and industrial services; later local reporting said no formal county data center applications were yet on file.
notes: Broad early-stage signal, not a named tenant or permitted data center. Included because the county notice explicitly lists data centers as initial district services and the district boundary covers Lincoln County lands plus a Sweetwater County parcel.

project_name: Prometheus Falls Ranch / Casper data center campus
status_detail: Prometheus announced a Falls Ranch site near Casper with up to 1.25 GW of data center capacity and a Casper Carbon Capture power partnership; Natrona County meeting materials and local coverage show public discussion/concern but do not establish final county permit approval located in this pass.
notes: Location described as near Casper/Falls Ranch and near the Natrona-Converse county line; capacity varies between the 1.25 GW developer release and 1.5 GW local reporting.

project_name: Mountain West Technologies Data Center of the Rockies
status_detail: County commission minutes document a business development grant tied to Mountain West Technologies' Casper data center utility costs, and the company's own materials describe data center colocation service.
notes: Small commercial colocation facility; no MW capacity found in this pass.

status_detail: No county data center project located from county/EDA-style searches or local/news searches.
notes: Searches produced a false-positive 'Niobrara Energy Park' data-center proposal in Weld County, Colorado, not Niobrara County, Wyoming. No Niobrara County WY facility, permit, rezoning, abatement, or EDA announcement found.

status_detail: No actual data center project located; only zoning/regulatory discussion about data centers and county commission debate.
notes: Local reporting says Park County was considering restrictions/prohibitions in most areas; no named developer, permit or site found.

project_name: Site Layer 4 Wheatland data center and power generation campus
status_detail: Official and EDA materials describe Site Layer 4 pursuing rezoning of about 5,344 acres northeast of Wheatland from agricultural to industrial for a large data center development with power generation; public hearing materials were active in 2026.
notes: The land-use case is clear; no tenant or final MW capacity found in this pass.

project_name: Range / Advanced Communications Technology Sheridan data center
status_detail: Colocation/tracker listings identify an operational Sheridan data center at 1 W Loucks Street operated by Advanced Communications Technology/Range with UPS and HVAC details.
notes: Appears to be a small telco colocation site. County official site searches did not surface a permit/abatement item.

project_name: Ptolemy Data Systems Sheridan data center
status_detail: Provider/brochure-style sources describe Ptolemy Data Systems operating a Sheridan data center with office/data-center space, vault space, backup generator and compliance controls.
notes: Small enterprise/managed-services data center; no MW capacity found.

status_detail: No in-county data center project located; only indirect energy-supply links to other Wyoming data center development and county zoning references to data centers as a possible land use.
notes: PureWest's Pinedale Field gas supply is tied to Prometheus power generation, but the data center site identified by Prometheus is in Uinta County, not Sublette County.

project_name: Lincoln Star Improvement and Service District data-center-enabling district - Sweetwater parcel
developer: Lincoln Star Improvement and Service District
status_detail: The Lincoln County notice for the proposed Lincoln Star ISD lists data centers among initial services and states the proposed district boundary includes a parcel in Sweetwater County.
notes: Not a confirmed Sweetwater County data center build; included as an early cross-county district signal because the official boundary description includes Sweetwater County land and data centers as a listed service.

status_detail: No Teton County data center project, permit, rezoning, or EDA announcement located.
notes: Jackson hosted a Data x Power Summit with state officials and hyperscaler executives, but this appears to be an industry/policy event, not a Teton County facility proposal. County documents mention internal county IT/data center spending only.

project_name: Prometheus Hyperscale Evanston AI data center campus
status_detail: Prometheus announced unanimous Uinta County conditional-use permit approval for a 506-acre Evanston site, over 2.2 million square feet, 1.25 GW initial capacity with stated potential to expand toward 5 GW, and construction targeted after final permitting.
notes: This is the clearest county-level project in the batch; developer says Uinta County commissioners approved the CUP on August 5, 2026.
